why: The two originals disagree on this distractor: the English file has "Ceramic plate", the Sinhala file has a chair. Decided 2026-09-20 to make both the plate. The Sinhala wording here is drafted, not Ishini's, and still needs her review.
Follows the text correction above. It also removes the only icon that differed between the two languages, which the merge wrapped as {en, si} and the app then printed as [object Object].

The Sinhala original spells the word for a port "කොවෙනිය" throughout lesson 2. The NIE term is "කෙවෙනිය" - one vowel sign, ො for ෙ. Reported by Ishini 2026-09-22. Ten occurrences: activity 2.1's name, instruction and four rounds, a statement in 2.2, and three of the option set names.
